<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->

         **Review examples:**
            1. _isidorast_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "they make your money off you not being able to cancel. I signed up for the free trial, forgot to cancel, and got charged. I tried to cancel and request a refund. not only did I not get a refund, I continued to be charged for months. and the bot in the app just tells you the same thing over and over again."
            2. _The-clown_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "I downgraded my subscription to a €12/month plan specifically to keep my account and accumulated credits active. ClassPass confirmed the new plan in writing, including the €12 price and effective date. One day later, the payment failed, the €12 option disappeared completely, and the only way to reactivate was to choose a more expensive €19/month plan. Even more concerning, ClassPass support acknowledged that I had successfully selected the €12 plan and that the system appeared to remove it after the payment issue, but they still refused to restore the confirmed offer. From a customer perspective, this feels like a tricky and misleading retention practice: offer a cheaper plan to keep you subscribed, remove it immediately afterwards, and then push you toward a higher-priced subscription. Very disappointing experience and not the level of transparency I would expect from a subscription business."
            3. _Emmma26_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "I would not recommend the ClassPass free trial based on my experience. I intentionally tried to cancel before I would be charged because I did not want the membership to renew. However, the website would not allow me to cancel early and instead instructed me to wait until the day my trial expired. When that day came, I was automatically charged $99. After contacting customer service, they did agree to refund me, but I was told it would take 5–10 business days for the money to be returned. What I find most frustrating is that ClassPass can take your money instantly, but you have to wait over a week to get it back—even when you tried to avoid being charged in the first place. In my opinion, not allowing customers to cancel before the renewal date is misleading and creates an unnecessary risk of unwanted charges. I’m sharing this so others are aware. If you sign up for the free trial, be extremely careful with the cancellation process, because you may end up in the same situation I did."
